## 2. Strategic Consulting Portfolio

### 2.1 SAP S/4HANA & ERP Cloud
- **Greenfield vs Brownfield**: Full feasibility assessment, data sanitization, custom ABAP code remediation for Unicode and HANA optimization.
- **SAP Central Finance (cFin)**: Real-time replication via SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT), Universal Journal (ACDOCA) single source of financial truth.
- **SAP BTP Extensibility**: Clean-core philosophy using side-by-side extensions in Node.js and Java, avoiding core system modification.
- **Fiori UI5 Development**: Custom role-tailored enterprise portals for procurement, sales order processing, and inventory management.
- **BASIS & AMS**: Continuous system monitoring, transport management, patch upgrades, and disaster recovery replication.

### 2.2 Corporate Strategy & Advisory
- Organizational restructuring, post-merger integration, process mining, and IT portfolio rationalization.

### 2.3 Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via Terraform, automated multi-region failover, Kubernetes cluster hardening, and full-stack telemetry.

### 2.4 Performance Marketing & 8D Motion Studio
- Programmatic audience segmentation across Google Display & Video 360, Meta Business Suite, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
- Average verified Return on Ad Spend: **5.2x ROAS**.
- 8D Binaural Sound Motion Video: proprietary audio spatialization using head-related transfer functions (HRTF) to create realistic 3D acoustic environments for consumer brand commercials.

## 3. Global Managed Services Portfolio

### 3.1 24/7 Application Support Services (AMS)
- Service Level Agreements:
  - **Priority 1 (Critical Outage)**: 15-minute response, war-room engagement with L3 senior architect, hourly stakeholder briefings.
  - **Priority 2 (Major Feature Impact)**: 60-minute response, 4-hour workaround delivery.
  - **Priority 3 (Minor Defect)**: 4-hour response, next-release patch.
  - **Priority 4 (Enhancement Request)**: 8-hour response.
- Observability Stack: Datadog APM, Dynatrace OneAgent, New Relic, Grafana Tempo, Prometheus, and PagerDuty routing.

### 3.2 International Voice Process
- Accent Neutralization: Proprietary voice modulation training ensuring effortless comprehension with North American (General American) and British (RP) native speakers.
- First Call Resolution: 91.2%.
- Customer Satisfaction: 96.4% CSAT.

### 3.3 Domestic Pan-India Voice Process
- Dialect Precision: Coverage across Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, and Odia.
- Average Speed to Answer (ASA): < 15 seconds.

### 3.4 Healthcare RCM
- End-to-end medical claims cycle, HIPAA compliance, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, and HCPCS Level II coding.

### 3.5 Pan-India Background Verification
- Field verification in all 28 states of India. Physical residence, past employer HR verification, criminal court record check via e-Courts system.
